register_few_shot_prompts: register few-shot example prompts for multimodal retrieval datasets using PromptRegistry.add
register_few_shot_with_cot_prompts: register few-shot with chain-of-thought prompts for multimodal retrieval datasets using PromptRegistry.add
add_multimodal_query_turns: add multimodal query turns with prefix and suffix formats to prompt query processors
append_reasoning_to_query_turns: append reasoning steps to query turns using a reasoning format template
append_gold_answers_to_query_turns: append gold answers to query turns using a final answer format template
convert_pids_into_gold_answers: convert prompt IDs into gold answer format for retrieval evaluation
add_text_chunks: add text chunks as context instructions to the prompt corpus
add_corpus_chunks_and_query_turns_from_f: add corpus chunks and query turns derived from few-shot examples with optional image chunks
